units: <cite ref="Chagigah 5b:12">Ḥag. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>חָרְבַּן בה״מ</he> the destruction of the Temple.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 26a:23">M. Kat. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>בחוֹרְבָּנָן</he> in their ruined state.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 4:6:4">Y. Kil. IV end, 29ᶜ</cite> <he>בחוֹרְבָּנוֹ</he> in its (the vineyard’s) waste state, opp. <cite ref="M01036"><he>מַטָּעָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 9b:4">Ab. Zar. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>לח׳ הבית</he> from the destruction of the Second Temple.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 56">Gen. R. s. 56</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 102:2">Yalk. Gen. 102</cite> <he>שהיתה … בשני ח׳</he> for she (Palmyra) took a part in both destructions of the Temple; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:4">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>בשתי ח׳</he> (fem.).
